allow: Bash(py -c "import json; nb=json.load\(open\('hmt_v3 test_script.ipynb'\)\); [print\(f'=== Cell {i} ===\\n', ''.join\(c['source']\)[:800], '\\n'\) for i,c in enumerate\(nb['cells']\) if 'inner' in ''.join\(c['source']\).lower\(\) or 'outer' in ''.join\(c['source']\).lower\(\) or \('rdf' in ''.join\(c['source']\).lower\(\) and 'extract' in ''.join\(c['source']\).lower\(\)\)]")

PowerShell($nb = Get-Content -Raw "manuscript_plotting.ipynb" | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "Total cells: $\($nb.cells.Count\)"; for \($i=0; $i -lt $nb.cells.Count; $i++\) { $c = $nb.cells[$i]; $src = \($c.source -join ''\); $preview = $src.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(80, $src.Length\)\) -replace "`n"," "; Write-Output "[$i] \($\($c.cell_type\)\) $preview" })
